paragraphs:
New England College is a private liberal arts college in Henniker, New Hampshire. Approximately 4,327 students enroll annually, with international students from over 25 countries in the world making up a part of this figure.

It is a private, top-ranked University known for degrees in health and life sciences, business, education, the social sciences, humanities, and more.

What is the acceptance rate for New England College?

The acceptance rate is 100% for New England College.

Students of music, art, and theater are also supported by specialized equipment. A gym, swimming pool, and fitness center are all accessible to students so they can find different ways to keep fit. The athletics complex also has an outside tennis court, soccer field, and track and field complex. The performing arts center contains a 500-seat theater, rehearsal spaces, and a black box theater, while the health center is situated conveniently to support a student's medical and mental health well-being.

Student Life

Henniker is the institution's main campus, although the Manchester campus is just 30 minutes outside, so activities can be enjoyed across both campuses. Campus life at New England College is known for being eventful. There are 20+ NCAA III sports teams, a range of student clubs covering all interests, from Design INK to the Environmental Action Committee, and opportunities to get involved with the WNEC 91.7 FM student radio station or The New Englander student newspaper. The Henniker campus houses Pats Peak, with free winter sports available.
